sources.title: Ling
sources.snippet: Ling-3.0-tiny Ling-3.0-tiny is a lightweight hybrid reasoning model in the Ling series designed for edge deployment scenarios, with 7.9B total parameters and only 1.3B activated parameters.

sources.title: inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny-base-30T · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This enables broad model capabilities while activating just 5.1B (Non-emb) parameters per token; Native hybrid linear attention: Ling-3.0 series adopt a native hybrid linear attention architecture from the very start of pretraining by combining KDA with Gated MLA to enable efficient processing of long-context inputs.

sources.title: Ling-3.0-tiny · LLM Releases
sources.snippet: Pitched as a highly economical on-device agent/reasoning model; weights are provided in BF16, FP8, and INT4 for a wide range of hardware. Vendor benchmark figures are unverified at launch. Ling-3.0-tiny is tracked as a open-weight model from Ant Group (inclusionAI). Released 2026-08-06.
